Its setup assertions still pass: both titles are in the data block, one record citation is stored, and a direct GET of the revoked uncited transformation returns 404. Then 'expect(reply.contentWithheld).toBe(false)' at line 159 fails with 'expected true to be false': after the revocation the answer has contentWithheld true and content null. It includes context-recheck 5/5, conversations 21, suggestions 12, injection, no-write and retrieval, the catalogue's 0128 cases, and my history probe (DOM-RG2-04). (3) mutant-f920.log: 2 failed of 5, exit 1. Case 1 (the uncited record revoked) and case 4 (the suggestion withheld, to-draft 404) fail, so the tests catch the revert. The source was restored and git status was clean. (4) Line review: all three read paths use recordRefsOf, the union of citations and context. Playbook citations no longer go through readable(), because citationViews only calls it for records. The context holds at most 20 keys, the same as retrieval MAX_ITEMS, so a full data block cannot breach the CHECK. The context must cover the citations; suggestions copy the answer's context and are immutable. context_records is never serialized: grep finds only conversations.ts and suggestions.ts reading it, and the inventory lists both columns as notServed. The pre-0128 fallback is disclosed consistently in ADR-0059 §9, the data dictionary and OpenAPI, and I accept it: no backfill is possible, and it affects only the owner of answers stored before the deploy. checks_run.procedure: Adversarial probe of the repaired §9 rule: is a withheld answer re-fed to the model as history on the next turn, and is the next answer re-checked against it? The probe combines the context-recheck.test.ts setup (lines 17-147) with my tail file. Turn 1 gives the model tA1 and tA2 and the fake cites tA1. Then tA2 is revoked, and the owner asks again in the same conversation.
checks_run.command: QA_PG_PORT=32600 MTH_PORT_POOL=32601-32649 tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh npx vitest run --configLoader runner --project integration apps/api/test/integration/assistant/zz-domain-r2-history.test.ts
checks_run.environment: Clone at 71ff750ed; disposable PostgreSQL 16.15; the shipped http_endpoint provider pointed at the local fake chat-completions server (loopback test double, not a model).
checks_run.expected: ADR-0059 §9: a revoked grant hides earlier answers, and the re-check covers every record an answer was generated from. Withheld content should not be given back to the model, or the new answer should be re-checked against it.
checks_run.actual: 1 passed, exit 0. The probe records observations and asserts only status 201. Turn 1 after the revocation has contentWithheld = true, so the F-DG6-920 repair holds. Turn 2: the request to the model has 5 messages, and the withheld turn-1 text naming 'Zephyrine synthetic program two' is sent as history = true. tA2 is not in the data block and not in the turn-2 context_records. The turn-2 answer is served with contentWithheld = false. historyOf (conversations.ts:440) takes stored answer content with no read-time check. A model asked to repeat its earlier answer can therefore restate hidden content, and §9 never sees it. Raised as F-DG6-960 (Medium, non-mandatory, the same class and bound as F-DG6-920: only the conversation owner, who could read the record when turn 1 was produced). Per D-192 a Medium cannot be accepted as an observation, so this check FAILs.

summary: FAIL on candidate d62b187b (2771 files, source 71ff750ed, product equal to ccd078e91). Both open findings are CLOSED_VERIFIED. For F-DG6-920, the round-1 reproduction now sees the answer withheld, and a mutant reverting the fix fails context-recheck. For F-DG6-900, the demo stack shows 'Comparison basis: Baseline and formula version validated by Finance' in en and ar, and a mutant restoring the old labels fails the unit tests. My regression runs pass: 82 integration files (834 tests plus 1 declared todo) and the root P6 e2e in en and ar (262 passed, 18 declared skips). One failure in that e2e run was a trace-artifact ENOENT caused by my own concurrent probe; the spec re-run alone passed 4/4. I raise one new Medium finding, F-DG6-960: a withheld answer is still sent to the model as history on the next turn, and the new answer is not re-checked against it. So the ADR-0059 §9 rule that 'a revoked grant hides earlier answers' can be bypassed by asking the assistant to repeat itself. A Medium must be repaired before the gate (D-192), so the verdict is FAIL.
